newCase.title: New case
newCase.subtitle: An Elastic or Wazuh case in the Incident Case Input v1.0 format. The backend checks every rule before it accepts it.
newCase.placeholder: Paste the case here or drop a .json file
newCase.empty: Paste or upload a case first.
newCase.syntax: This is not valid JSON. Check line {{line}}, column {{column}}.

contract.title: What the backend checks
contract.alerts: Between {{min}} and {{max}} alerts per case, each from {{sources}}. Unknown fields inside raw_alert are kept as they are.

accepted.title: Case accepted
accepted.body: Case {{id}} is stored and ready to investigate.

invalid.body: Nothing was stored. Fix these and submit again.
invalid.stale: You changed the case after this check. Submit again to recheck it.

duplicate.title: This case was already submitted
duplicate.body: Its case_id has been accepted before. Give it a new case_id to submit it again.

offline.title: Can't reach the backend
offline.body: Check that the backend is running on port 8000, then try again.

failed.title: The backend answered {{status}}
failed.noDetail: It sent no details. The backend terminal log should say more.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong reading the answer
unexpected.body: The browser could not read what came back: {{message}}

entry.title: Who is investigating?
entry.body: Your name goes on every review you record. This Alpha has no passwords yet, so the name stays in this browser only.
entry.help: Use the name your team knows you by.

missing.title: No case with this ID
missing.body: The backend has no case stored under this application ID. It may be a typo, or the backend database was reset.

notRun.title: Not investigated yet
notRun.body: The case is stored. Run the agent to get its report.

run.title: Investigating the case
run.body: The agent correlates the alerts, maps ATT&CK techniques, builds the timeline and checks the attached IoCs. The demo case takes a few seconds. Larger cases can take a few minutes.

failed.timeout: The investigation ran out of time

pageTimeout.title: No answer after {{limit}}
pageTimeout.body: The backend never answered. It may have stopped while the agent was running.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong reading the answer

failed.kept: Your case is still stored, so you can run it again without submitting it twice.

hypotheses.none: The agent formed no hypothesis for this case.

actions.approval: Needs an analyst's approval before anyone acts on it.

mitre.intro: Techniques carry a status, not a confidence. A candidate matches the alert pattern and still needs an analyst to confirm it.
mitre.none: The agent mapped no ATT&CK techniques for this case.

review.title: Analyst review
review.soon: Recording a review from this screen comes in the next update.
